title: Gravity-weakening experiments with pulsed EM fields

tellings.quote: Uh we got experiments where we uh found we could pulse electromagnetic fields and uh uh get a local weakening of gravity that we could easily measure was like a one part per thousand.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg told the podcast host Jesse Michels about experiments he connects to a meeting of the American Physical Society, a professional body for physicists. He says that by sending pulses of electromagnetic energy, the kind behind magnets and radio waves, they got gravity to weaken in a small area, by about one part in a thousand, and that it was easy to measure. If true, it would mean gravity can be controlled in the lab.
